idea-plugin.name: GlassBox Lite
idea-plugin.description: Audit explicitly selected editor text for arithmetic errors, direct contradictions, unsupported certainty, citation-transparency gaps, and prompt-injection signals. Each audit requires explicit confirmation and sends only the selected text and supplied question to the public zero-cost GlassBox Lite service. No API key, telemetry, automatic file scan, or background upload is included. GlassBox Lite is not a web fact-check, source authenticator, truth guarantee, or professional advice.

action.description: Run a privacy-minimized structural reasoning audit on explicitly selected text
